According to the BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations and associated guidelines, here are the specific rules regarding e-labelling, website reference marking, host device integration, and licence updates: [1]

### Display of BIS Website Reference with E-Labelling
* The BIS website reference (`www.bis.gov.in`) must be marked on the product, its package, or both [2].
* This marking requirement is mandatory even if the reference to the BIS website is already provided via e-labelling on the product [2].

### Application to Products Intended for Integration into a Host Device
* **Before and after integration:** Registered products meant to be integrated or built into a host product must comply with the requirement of marking the BIS website reference [2].

### Administrative Document for Standard Revision Updates
* The specific administrative document used as an attachment to update the Indian Standard number or details on a licence (such as during renewals or changes) is **Form-XIII** (under Scheme-I regulations) [3].

Next step: Visit Manak Online at https://www.manakonline.in/

**Sources:**

[2] Marking requirement as per BIS (CA) Regulations: Regulation 2. The provision of e-labelling also exists for which guidelines as per circula, p. 1, dated 2019-09-06 | https://www.crsbis.in/BIS/app_srv/tdc/gl/docs/Marking%20requirement%20as%20per%20BIS%20(Conformity%20Assessment)%20Regulations.pdf#page=1
[3] BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018: Form - XII > Scheme-I > 5. Names and addresses of all purchasers of BIS, p. 296, dated 2018 | https://www.bis.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2019/03/BIS_CA_12032019.pdf#page=296

भारतीय मानक ब्यूरो (BIS) के 28 अप्रैल, 2026 के कॉरिजेंडम (सुधार सूची) के अनुसार, जो 25 फरवरी, 2026 की BIS (सामंजस्य मूल्यांकन) संशोधनRegulations, 2026 के संबंध में जारी किया गया था, अनुसूची-2 के योजना-IV (Scheme-IV) में अनुच्छेद 8 के उप-खंड (1) के अंतर्गत प्रमाणपत्र की अवधि के संबंध में यह संशोधन किया गया है कि पृष्ठ 70 पर योजना-IV की अनुसूची-2 के पैराग्राफ 8 के उप-पैराग्राफ (1) के प्रतिस्थापन (substitution) के संबंध में सुधार किया गया है [1]। 

इस संबंध में उपलब्ध आधिकारिक दस्तावेजों में केवल यह संदर्भ दिया गया है कि यह सुधार पृष्ठ 70 पर योजना-IV के पैराग्राफ 8 के उप-पैराग्राफ (1) के प्रतिस्थापन के लिए है [1]।

This part is not covered in the official BIS documents I have.

Next step: https://www.bis.gov.in

जब किसी प्रमाण पत्र (लाइसेंस) को निलंबित (suspend) किया जाता है, तो प्रमाणपत्र धारक पर निम्नलिखित प्रतिबंध लगते हैं:

* निलंबन की अवधि के दौरान, आपको (प्रमाणपत्र धारक को) उत्पाद पर 'मानक चिह्न' (Standard Mark) का उपयोग और प्रयोग करने की अनुमति नहीं होती है [1][2]।
* आपको मानक चिह्न के साथ उक्त उत्पाद को (हाथ में मौजूद स्टॉक सहित) भेजने (dispatch) की अनुमति नहीं होती है [1][2]।

This part is not covered in the official BIS documents I have.

Next step: https://www.manakonline.in/

**स्रोत:**
[1] Guidelines for Dealing with Product Non-Conformity (25 Feb 2026): Annexure-XII, p. 37, dated 2026-02-25 | https://www.bis.gov.in/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Dealing-WithNon-Conformity-Guidelines-25Feb2026.pdf#page=37

Here's what you need to do to challenge the rejection of your Certificate of Conformity (CoC) under Scheme IV:

* **Deadline for filing an appeal**: You must prefer your appeal within ninety days from the date of the order [1].
* **Required fee**: The appeal must be submitted with a fee of two thousand rupees, as per the provisions of section 34 of the BIS Act, 2016 read along with Rule 37 of the BIS Rules, 2018 [1].

Next step: Visit Manak Online at https://www.manakonline.in/ to file your appeal.

Here's what you need to do.

### Is it allowed?
Yes, you can still obtain a BIS licence even if product-specific guidelines like the Product Manual, Scheme of Inspection and Testing (SIT), grouping guidelines, and/or marking fee rate are not defined for your product [1].

### Which scheme applies
* **Scheme I (ISI Licence)**: You will be able to obtain the BIS licence as per Scheme I of the BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018 [1].

### Why this happens
It is possible that you are the first manufacturer to apply for a BIS licence for this new product [1].

### What happens next
* The basic principles and procedure for the grant of the licence will remain the same, with specific relaxations [1].

Next step: Visit Manak Online to submit your application: https://www.manakonline.in/

**Sources:**

यहाँ Foreign Manufacturers Certification Scheme (FMCS: विदेशी निर्माता प्रमाणन योजना) के तहत लाइसेंस के लिए आवेदन करने की प्रक्रिया और कागज़ात की जानकारी दी गई है:

**आवेदन प्रक्रिया और चरण:**
1. आवेदन पत्र और फॉर्म: आवेदन, एफएमसीसीएस (FMCS) के तहत उपलब्ध फॉर्म और फॉर्मेट में किया जाता है [1]। आवेदन मैनलाइन पोर्टल (manakonline portal) के माध्यम से ऑनलाइन भी जमा किए जा सकते हैं [2]।
2. आवेदन जमा करना: भरा हुआ और पूर्ण आवेदन, आवश्यक शुल्क, कागजात (दो प्रतियों में) और AIR (Authorized Indian Representative: अधिकृत भारतीय प्रतिनिधि) का नामांकन फॉर्म एफएमसीडी (FMCD), BIS मुख्यालय, नई दिल्ली में जमा किया जाता है [2]।
3. AIR का नामांकन: विदेशी आवेदक को एक भारतीय निवासी को अपने अधिकृत भारतीय प्रतिनिधि (AIR) के रूप में नामित करना अनिवार्य है [1]।

**ज़रूरी कागज़ात और आवश्यकताएं:**
* आवेदन में बताए गए सभी प्रासंगिक दस्तावेज़ [1]।
* दस्तावेजों की चेकलिस्ट के अनुसार पूर्ण आवेदन [2]।
* AIR (अधिकृत भारतीय प्रतिनिधि) का नामांकन फॉर्म [2]।
* एक ही विनिर्माण परिसर में निर्मित किसी उत्पाद के विभिन्न ब्रांडों के लिए अलग-अलग आवेदन नहीं करने होते, बल्कि फर्म को प्रासंगिक दस्तावेजों के साथ ब्रांड नाम के लिए एक वचन पत्र (undertaking) देना होता है [1]।

This part is not covered in the official BIS documents I have: शुल्क की सटीक राशि और विशिष्ट समयसीमा की पूरी विस्तृत सूची [2][1]।

Next step: https://www.manakonline.in/

Here is how the official BIS documents handle a standard revision or amendment affecting a licence: [1]

* **Applicability of Revisions/Amendments:** The latest version of Indian Standards, including any amendments issued, applies to implementing provisions under Quality Control Orders (QCOs) [2]. Any amendment or revision made by the Bureau to an Indian Standard applies with effect from the date notified by the Bureau [3][4][5].
* **Consequences of Non-Implementation:** Non-implementation of a revision or amendment to an Indian Standard within the specified time is treated as a case of unsatisfactory performance, leading to proceedings such as suspension of the licence [1].
* **Explanation and Notice:** If a licensee fails to implement a revision or amendment, the Head of the Branch Office (BO) seeks an explanation from the manufacturer, giving a specified time (such as 15 days) [1].

Next step: Visit [Manak Online](https://www.manakonline.in/) for managing your licence details and updates.

Under the BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018, the specific regulatory provisions and framework details are as follows: [1]

* **Basis for Deferring a Scheme-I Licence:** The decision to defer the renewal of a Scheme-I licence for a maximum duration of one year from the date of its validity is made pursuant to **sub-paragraph (6) of paragraph 9 of Scheme-I of Schedule-II** of the BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018 [2].
* **Regulatory Status Assigned:** Under **sub-paragraph (6) and (7) of paragraph 9 of Scheme-I of Schedule-II** of the Regulations, the licence is specifically categorised as **‘dormant’** [2]. During this period, the licensee has no right to use the Standard Mark [2].

Here's what you need to know about the department granting Foreign Manufacturers Certification Scheme (FMCS) licences and the primary purpose of a Cluster Based Test Facility (CBTF):

* **Grant of FMCS Licences:** The licence under FMCS is granted by the Foreign Manufacturers Certification Department (FMCD) located at the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) Headquarters in New Delhi [1].
* **Primary Purpose of CBTF for MSMEs:** Due to the inability of some industries in the country to employ separate testing facilities and technical personnel for quality control and BIS certification purposes, the CBTF concept was formulated with the primary objectives of: [2]
  - Having a common testing facility for a group of industries in a cluster [2].
  - Helping each industry operate the BIS certification marks scheme by allowing testing of products for the operation of the Scheme of Inspection and Testing (SIT) [3][2].
  - Serving as an alternative to an in-house testing facility for MSMEs [4].

Next step: Visit Manak Online at https://www.manakonline.in/ to apply for or manage a licence.
